title: Root-account activity recorded
description: A root identity appears in an event. Root privileges warrant review. Check the recorded outcome and whether this use was authorized.
falsepositives: Approved account recovery or a task requiring root access.
recommended_action: Confirm the operator and approved task. Review authentication details, the event outcome, and nearby root events.
notes: Educational Sigma-style subset. A finding is an investigation lead.
Uses the existing ATT&CK v17 reference snapshot where mapped.
